title: Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1982-09-15
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) ->Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: High‑energy jam‑filled show captured on a crisp soundboard recording with occasional crunch, highlighted by Playin > Crazy Fingers sequences and a killer Shakedown.
ai_review.review: The performance is driven by nonstop jamming – the Playin > Crazy Fingers > Playin thread runs through the set, with standout moments like Shakedown, Sailor into Saint, and a beautiful Stella. The board‑recorded source is generally clear and lively, though it gets a bit crunchy on tracks such as Saint and NFA. Overall the show is regarded as an exciting early‑'80s Dead outing despite some volume‑level complaints.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave 5‑star ratings and praised the musical flow, while noting minor recording crunch and volume issues; this yields a strong show rating tempered by modest technical flaws.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and lively board capture using Healy's AKG mics, with occasional crunchy distortion on Saint and NFA and a few minor drop‑outs noted by one reviewer.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Jam‑centric flow that feels like a second set with first‑set tunes interspersed; the Playin motif ties the whole concert together.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Oddly, Jerry did not make much of an impression for one reviewer, though his playing is not criticized outright.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob's slide work drew mixed reactions – some love it, others think he should have stopped the slide during Red Rooster.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent (new keyboardist) is noted as adding to the 'auditory assault' especially on Red Rooster.
band_member_comments.Drums: The dual drummers ('The Beast') received strong praise for their power and spacey playing.
